NEWSANGUO_CARD_STRIKE_CAOWEI.title: Strike
NEWSANGUO_CARD_STRIKE_SHUHAN.title: Strike
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DEFEND_CAOWEI.title: Defend
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DEFEND_SHUHAN.title: Defend
NEWSANGUO_CARD_A_GRAND_TOAST.title: A Grand Toast
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BLADES_OF_VIRTUE.title: Blades of Virtue
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BLADES_OF_VIRTUE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CROSS_THE_RIVER_TOO.title: Cross the River Too!
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CROSS_THE_RIVER_TOO.descr: If the enemy intends to attack, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_FEEL_NO_ACID.title: Feel No Acid
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MA_CLAN_QUAD_BLAST.title: Ma Clan Quad Blast
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MA_CLAN_QUAD_BLAST.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SLAM_THE_BOWL.title: Slam the Bowl
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SLAM_THE_BOWL.description:
Discard a random card from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a copy of this card into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_TO_A_BIGGER_GOBLET.title: To a Bigger Goblet
NEWSANGUO_CARD_TO_A_BIGGER_GOBLET.descri: Whenever you gain {WinePowerName}, gain an additional {ToABiggerGobletPower:diff()} {WinePowerName}.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WINE_IS_THE_OLD_HERO.desc:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {CalculationExtra:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each point of [gold]Drunken Might[/gold] you have.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_STARRY_NIGHT.title: Starry Night
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SCORCHING_STARFALL.title: Scorching Starfall
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SCORCHING_STARFALL.descri:
For every {WineThreshold:inverseDiff()} [gold]Drunken Might[/gold] you have, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} times.)|}
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DIVINATION.title: Divination
NEWSANGUO_CARD_VICTORY_BY_HEAVENS_WILL.d: At the start of your turn, gain {VictoryByHeavensWillPower} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MIND_CONTROL_SPELL.title: Mind Control Spell
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MIND_CONTROL_SPELL.descri:
Lose {HeavensForcePower:inverseDiff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
Apply {BewildermentPower:diff()} [gold]Bewilderment[/gold] to an enemy.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_PEEK_INTO_HEAVEN.title: Peek Into Heaven
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DESECRATE_HEAVEN.title: Desecrate Heaven
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DESECRATE_HEAVEN.descript:
Gain {HeavensForcePower:diff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
[gold]Retain[/gold] your hand this turn.
At the start of your turn, lose {VictoryByHeavensWillPower:inverseDiff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SMILING_TIGER.title: Smiling Tiger
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SMILING_TIGER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you draw this card, add a copy of it to your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DARK_HORN_SHARK.title: Dark Horn Shark
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DARK_HORN_SHARK.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you draw this card, add a copy of it to your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SOLDIER.title: Soldier
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SON_OF_HEAVEN.title: Son of Heaven
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SON_OF_HEAVEN.description:
Gain {HeavensForcePower:diff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
In this combat, the [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold] gained by this card is reduced by 1.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HUMAN_TRANSMUTATION_SPELL:
[gold]Transform[/gold] any number of cards in your hand into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soldier+|Soldier}[/gold].
Lose 1 gold for each card transformed.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SEA_CHANGE.title: Sea Change
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SEA_CHANGE.description:
Choose up to {Cards:diff()} cards in your hand to [gold]Transform[/gold], and add a random [gold]Enchant[/gold] to them.
Gain 1 [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold] for each card transformed.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SEA_CHANGE.selectionScree: Choose up to {Cards} cards to [gold]Transform[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_THROW_HIM_OUT.title: Throw Him Out!
NEWSANGUO_CARD_THROW_HIM_OUT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVEN_REVISION.title: Heaven Revision
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MEDICAL_MASTERY.title: Medical Mastery
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MEDICAL_MASTERY.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] multiple times.
When it [gold]kills[/gold] an enemy, permanently [gold]Upgrade[/gold] itself (twice during [gold]Elite[/gold] or [gold]Boss[/gold] [gold]fights[/gold]).{IsClone:
[purple]Killing an enemy with this copy will not Upgrade it.[/purple]|}
NEWSANGUO_CARD_TWEAK.title: Tweak
NEWSANGUO_CARD_TWEAK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a random [gold]Enchant[/gold] to {IfUpgraded:show:all|one} un-[gold]Enchanted[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_FALL_ON_OWN_SWORD.title: Fall on Your Own Sword!
NEWSANGUO_CARD_FALL_ON_OWN_SWORD.descrip:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
This turn, whenever you play a card, you take {HpCostPerCard:diff()} damage.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_RELEASE.title: Release
NEWSANGUO_CARD_RELEASE.description: At the end of combat, heal {HealAmount:diff()} HP and play the "Song of Guan Yu" or its variants.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_INVINCIBLE.title: Invincible!
NEWSANGUO_CARD_INVINCIBLE.description: If you don't have [gold]Flight[/gold], deal {BonusPercent:diff()}% more damage to enemies that don't have [gold]Flutter[/gold] or [gold]Soar[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CRICKET_FORM.title: Cricket Form
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CRICKET_FORM.description:
Set your [gold]Hard to Kill[/gold] to {HardToKillPower:inverseDiff()}.
At the start of each of your turns, double your [gold]Hard to Kill[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CHOW_DOWN.title: Chow Down
NEWSANGUO_CARD_TRIUMPH_BREW.title: Triumph Brew
NEWSANGUO_CARD_TRIUMPH_BREW.description: Whenever you gain {WinePowerName}, other [gold]allies[/gold] gain the same amount of [gold]Drunken Might[/gold]. (Doesn't trigger another ally's "Triumph Brew")
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WHAT_TO_EAT.title: What to Eat
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WHAT_TO_EAT.description: Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Chow Down+|Chow Down}[/gold] to all players' hands.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVEN_HATING_SWORDPLAY.d:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Heaven[/gold]-related card you have.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_RUTHLESS_BLADE.title: Ruthless Blade
NEWSANGUO_CARD_RUTHLESS_BLADE.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to the target.
Apply {FrailPower:diff()} [gold]Frail[/gold] to yourself.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BONE_MELTING_PALM.title: Bone-Melting Palm
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BONE_MELTING_PALM.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Make the target lose {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WOLF_VS_DOG.title: Wolf vs Dog
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WOLF_VS_DOG.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy has more HP than you, attack twice.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CENTRAL_PLAINS_PASS.title: Central Plains Pass
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CENTRAL_PLAINS_PASS.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you take no unblocked damage before your next turn, gain {NextTurnBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_PROXY_STRIKE.title: Proxy Strike
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WHO_RULES.title: Who Rules
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WHO_RULES.description:
Apply {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to another player.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Put this card into that player's [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If your [gold]Drunken Might[/gold] is at least {WineThreshold:inverseDiff()}:
Stun ALL enemies.
All players discard all cards in their [gold]Hand[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CHAIN_STRATAGEM.title: Chain Stratagem
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CHAIN_STRATAGEM.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase this card's damage by {Increment:diff()} for the rest of combat.
Put this card into a random [gold]ally[/gold]'s hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LIGHTNING_STRIKE.title: Lightning Strike
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LIGHTNING_STRIKE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have played fewer than {PlayMax:diff()} cards this turn, gain {HeavensForcePower:diff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WINE_CUT.title: Wine Cut
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WINE_CUT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
After dealing damage, refund the [gold]Drunken Might[/gold] this card consumed.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ALWAYS_MINE.title: Always Mine
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ALWAYS_MINE.description:
Gain {HeavensForcePower:diff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
Put {Cards:diff()} card(s) from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Ember[/gold]: Play this card.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ONE_MAN_STAND.title: One Man Stand
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ONE_MAN_STAND.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold], then discard the rest.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SELECT_TRANSFORM_TO: Choose a card to Transform into {Target}
NEWSANGUO_CARD_QUAKE_BEFORE_ME.title: Quake Before Me!
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BETTER_THAN_YILING_FLAMES:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Exhaust any number of cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
This card permanently deals {Increase:diff()} additional damage for each card Exhausted.{IsClone:
[purple]Playing this copy will not increase the original's damage.[/purple]|}
NEWSANGUO_CARD_JUST_KIDDING.title: Just Kidding
NEWSANGUO_CARD_JUST_KIDDING.description:
Put a card from your hand on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Its cost becomes 0 until it is played.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_JUST_KIDDING.selectionScr: Choose a card from your hand to put on top of your Draw Pile.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BETTER_EACH_DAY.title: Better Each Day
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BETTER_EACH_DAY.descripti: Next turn, draw {IfUpgraded:show:X+2|X+1} cards and gain {IfUpgraded:show:X+2|X+1}{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_RETIRE.title: Retire
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BREW_HEALS_ALL.title: Brew Heals All
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BREW_HEALS_ALL.descriptio: Spend {DrunkenMight:inverseDiff()} [gold]Drunken Might[/gold]: remove all your [gold]debuffs[/gold], and Exhaust all your [gold]Curses[/gold] and [gold]Status[/gold] cards.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SELECT_FROM_DISCARD: Choose up to {Amount} {Amount:plural:card|cards} to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SELECT_ONE_TO_KEEP: Choose a card to keep in your hand
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CHECK_THE_PREMIERE.title: Check the Premiere
NEWSANGUO_CARD_CHECK_THE_PREMIERE.descri: Randomly obtain the [gold]original version[/gold] of a card that was [gold]nerfed in an update[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show:, Upgraded}.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_FORGOTTEN_RITUAL.desc: If you [gold]Exhausted[/gold] a card this turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_BORROWED_TIME.title: Old Borrowed Time
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_DIRGE.title: Old Dirge
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_DIRGE.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()} X times.
Add X [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Souls+|Souls}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_COMPACT.title: Old Compact
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_COMPACT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Transform[/gold] all Status cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Old Fuel+|Old Fuel}[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_FUEL.title: Old Fuel
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_EXPECT_A_FIGHT.title: Old Expect a Fight
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OLD_EXPECT_A_FIGHT.descri:
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold].{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedEnergy:energyIcons()})|}
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVEN_AND_EARTH.title: Heaven and Earth
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVEN_AND_EARTH.descript: While held, gain {FlightPower:diff()} [gold]Flight[/gold] at the start of your turn.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DEAFEN_ME.title: Deafen Me
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DEAFEN_ME.description:
Apply {DragonOmenPower:diff()} [gold]Dragon Omen[/gold].
Reduce the volume of sounds you hear by 25% this combat.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DRAGON_OMEN.title: Dragon Omen
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD.title: Off With Your Head!
NEWSANGUO_CARD_OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy's intent is not an [gold]Attack[/gold], attack twice.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SECRET_STRATAGEM.title: Secret Stratagem
NEWSANGUO_CARD_SECRET_STRATAGEM.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you have exactly 2 cards left in your hand after playing this card, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_REANIMATION_SPELL.title: Reanimation Spell
NEWSANGUO_CARD_REANIMATION_SPELL.descrip:
Lose {HeavensForcePower:inverseDiff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
Choose any number of cards from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] and put them into your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LONGEVITY_SPELL.title: Longevity Spell
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LONGEVITY_SPELL.descripti:
Lose {HeavensForcePower:inverseDiff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
[purple]Enchant[/purple] any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] that have [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and no [gold]Enchant[/gold], with [gold]Soul Power[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LONGEVITY_SPELL.selection: Choose any number of cards to [purple]Enchant[/purple].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_FATHER_CAN_CLAIM_THE_THRO: At the start of your turn, lose {VictoryByHeavensWillPower:inverseDiff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold], gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, and draw {DrawCount} additional cards.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEW_GAME_PLUS.title: New Game Plus
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEW_GAME_PLUS.description:
Gain {DrunkenMightPower:diff()} [gold]Drunken Might[/gold].
Gain {HeavensForcePower:diff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
Scry {ScryAmount}.
Draw a card.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BREW_LIMIT_BREAK.title: Brew Limit Break
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEAR_AND_FAR.title: Near and Far
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEAR_AND_FAR.description:
Gain {NearAndFarPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
On the following turns, you alternately gain {NearAndFarPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and {NearAndFarPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ONSET.title: Onset
NEWSANGUO_CARD_THE_TRUEST_MASK.title: The Truest Mask
NEWSANGUO_CARD_THE_TRUEST_MASK.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_THREE_BLADES.title: Three Blades
NEWSANGUO_CARD_THREE_BLADES.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
If this card [gold]kills[/gold] an enemy, refund the [gold]Drunken Might[/gold] this card consumed and gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)}.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_COMMANDER_ARRIVES.title: Commander Arrives
NEWSANGUO_CARD_COMMANDER_ARRIVES.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Military Cudgel[/gold] to your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_FORTY_SIXTY_TAX.title: Forty-Sixty Tax
NEWSANGUO_CARD_FORTY_SIXTY_TAX.descripti:
Gain Gold equal to {TaxPercent}% of the target's [gold]current HP[/gold], divided by the number of players.{IsTargeting:
(Gain {TaxGold:diff()} Gold)|}
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVENLY_TROOPS.title: Heavenly Troops
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVENLY_TROOPS.descripti:
Lose {HeavensForcePower:inverseDiff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
After {TurnDelay} turns end, add {SoldierCount} [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soldier+|Soldier}[/gold] to your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_QIN_JIN_ALLIANCE.title: Qin and Jin Alliance
NEWSANGUO_CARD_QIN_JIN_ALLIANCE.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose an enemy. It gains {EnemyBlock} [gold]Block[/gold] (unaffected by [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and the like).
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LETS_DISCUSS.title: Let's Discuss
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LETS_DISCUSS.description:
Draw cards until your hand is full.
Discard that many cards.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DIVINE_INSIGHT.title: Divine Insight
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DIVINE_INSIGHT.descriptio:
Lose {HeavensLost} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
Whenever you play a card, gain {DivineInsightPower:diff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEVER_HAD_THESE.title: Never Had These
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEVER_HAD_THESE.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Exhaust all non-Attack cards in your hand. Gain {HeavensForcePower:diff()} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold] for each.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_GREAT_EVIL.title: Great Evil
NEWSANGUO_CARD_GREAT_EVIL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If your [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold] is 0 or less, gain {HeavensForcePower} [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MILITARY_CUDGEL.title: Military Cudgel
NEWSANGUO_CARD_INTOXICATED.title: Intoxicated
NEWSANGUO_CARD_INTOXICATED.description:
Gain {DrunkenMightPower:diff()} [gold]Drunken Might[/gold].
If the last card you played was a [gold]Skill[/gold], gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_IM_GETTING_DRUNK.title: I'm Getting Drunk
NEWSANGUO_CARD_IM_GETTING_DRUNK.descript:
Gain {DrunkenMightPower:diff()} [gold]Drunken Might[/gold].
Add a [gold]Lightweight[/gold] to your [gold]hand[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WHY_PICK_THAT_UP.title: Why Pick That Up
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WHY_PICK_THAT_UP.descript: Next turn, all players choose up to {ReturnCount:diff()} cards from their [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] and add them to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_UNCLES_AND_AUNTS.title: Uncles and Aunts
NEWSANGUO_CARD_UNCLES_AND_AUNTS.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and deal {Damage:diff()} damage {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} times.
This card's values are affected by both [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HAN_XIN.title: Han Xin
NEWSANGUO_CARD_BAI_QI.title: Bai Qi
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ZHOU_YAFU.title: Zhou Yafu
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MY_THREE_GENERALS.title: My Three Generals
NEWSANGUO_CARD_MY_THREE_GENERALS.descrip:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Choose [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Han Xin+|Han Xin}[/gold], [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Bai Qi+|Bai Qi}[/gold], or [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Zhou Yafu+|Zhou Yafu}[/gold] and add it to your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ASSIGNMENT.title: Assignment
NEWSANGUO_CARD_ASSIGNMENT.description:
Choose an Attack or Skill card in your hand to record.
At the start of your turn, choose a [gold]Hand[/gold] card to [gold]Transform[/gold] into the recorded card.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_WHERES_WINE.title: Where's Wine
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEVER_HAPPENED.title: Never Happened
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NEVER_HAPPENED.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put the next card you play this turn on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_PARTY_ON.title: Party On
NEWSANGUO_CARD_PARTY_ON.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards} cards.
You cannot play [gold]Attacks[/gold] this turn.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_INVOKE_HEAVEN.title: Invoke Heaven
NEWSANGUO_CARD_GOLDEN_REBELLION.title: Golden Rebellion
NEWSANGUO_CARD_GOLDEN_REBELLION.descript:
Choose 1 of 3 {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded }[gold]Rare cards[/gold] and add it to your hand.
It can be played for free this turn.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NONSENSE.title: Nonsense
NEWSANGUO_CARD_NONSENSE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Randomize the cost of all cards in your hand this turn.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_TIGER_WIND_CLOUD_DRAGON.d:
Whenever you play a [gold]Tiger-Dragon[/gold] card, draw {TigerWindCloudDragonPower:diff()} cards.
Add a [gold]Smiling Tiger[/gold] and a [gold]Dragon Omen[/gold] to your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_VENOM_RAT.title: Venom Rat
NEWSANGUO_CARD_RAT_POISON_SCHEME.title: Rat Poison Scheme
NEWSANGUO_CARD_RAT_POISON_SCHEME.descrip: At the start of your turn, add a [gold]Venom Rat[/gold] to your hand.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVENS_DECAY.title: Heaven's Decay
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HEAVENS_DECAY.description:
Set your [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold] to 0 and gain 1 [gold]Heaven's Decay[/gold].
[gold]Ember[/gold]: Play this card.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_DESPERATE_RESOLVE_WEI.des:
Whenever you play a card, [gold]Recruit[/gold] 1.
Whenever any creature dies, you gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HUNGRY.title: Hungry
NEWSANGUO_CARD_HUNGRY.description: At the end of your turn, if this card is in your hand, you draw {DrawReductionPower:diff()} fewer card next turn.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_I_CANT_LEAVE.title: I Can't Leave!
NEWSANGUO_CARD_I_CANT_LEAVE.description:
Return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Ember[/gold]: Play this card.
NEWSANGUO_CARD_LIGHTWEIGHT.title: Lightweight
